integrity: Exact finite integer-bitmask recurrence, independent topological-sort enumeration, a separate depth-ten decision check and a complete 512-leaf depth-nine witness tree are supplied. These do not amount to independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact adaptive classification is restricted to 2 through 8 positions; no higher-order formula is claimed. The static formula is previously known for all finite posets of height two. Historical-priority comparison remains subject to alternate terminology and unindexed sources.
title: Exact finite online-shattering thresholds for alternating permutations
